title: Quasi-coherent cohomology vanishes above the dimension of a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] (a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $q\geq0$ be strictly larger than the topological Krull dimension of $X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then the Zariski sheaf cohomology group $H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ [def-sc-zariski-site], [pqf-def-cohomology] is zero. The assertion also includes $X=\varnothing$, whose topological dimension is $-\infty$.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ (cohomology-proposition-vanishing-Noetherian), applied to the underlying Noetherian topological space and the abelian sheaf of a quasi-coherent module

proof.text: For nonempty X, the closure of a point is an irreducible closed subset, so its topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] is nonnegative. Thus q cannot be zero. Write q=n+1; the discrete WithBot extended-natural order converts dim X < n+1 into dim X ≤ n. Apply [lem-sc-zariski-dimension-bound] to the underlying abelian sheaf of the module, obtaining that Sheaf.H' F (n+1) top is zero. The free abelian presheaf on yoneda(top) is isomorphic to the constant presheaf ULift Z: each Hom(U,top) is a singleton and its free abelian group is Z. Sheafify this natural isomorphism and precompose Ext with it. This identifies Sheaf.H F (n+1), which is definitionally Modules.H, with the vanishing group. No module-derived-cohomology comparison theorem is required.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ; Mathlib FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv and Ext precomposition along an isomorphism

proof.text: For empty X, the underlying abelian sheaf has no stalks. The Mathlib zero-sheaf criterion checked on all stalks is vacuous, hence the sheaf is zero. Its cohomology in every degree is zero because the additive cohomology functor maps zero objects to zero objects (Sheaf.subsingleton_H_of_isZero). This handles q=0 as well as positive q, without flasque acyclicity.
